svg.title: Cuff hyperinflation for tracheo-innominate fistula
svg.desc: Original illustration. Midline sagittal section of the lower neck, front of neck to the left. A tracheostomy tube enters through the stoma; its cuff is hyperinflated with about 50 mL of air from a syringe on the pilot balloon. The swollen cuff presses outward on the anterior tracheal wall where the innominate artery crosses in front of the trachea, tamponading the fistula.
